title: Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through Lines on C&I Bills
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - capacity and transmission lines.**

1. On a structure whose capacity cost is passed through, each cycle carries one capacity charge line equal to the facility's peak load contribution in kW multiplied by the capacity price in effect on the billing period start, multiplied by the billing days, divided by 1000 kW per MW, rounded half up to the cent.
2. On a structure whose transmission cost is passed through, each cycle carries one transmission charge line equal to the facility's transmission obligation in kW multiplied by the transmission rate in effect on the billing period start, multiplied by the billing days, divided by 1000 kW per MW, rounded half up to the cent.
3. The price or rate in effect is that of the latest capacity price or transmission rate notice on the contract whose effective date is on or before the billing period start.
4. A cycle that spans a June 1 capacity year change is billed entirely at the price in effect on its billing period start.
5. When the grid operator revises a tag, past cycles are not re-billed, because the structures provide no retroactive tag true-up.
6. During holdover, capacity and transmission are always passed through, whatever the expired structure was.
7. On structures where the cost is included, no separate line is billed, and a separate line billed is a billing error.

## Which notice prices the cycle (hypothetical notices)

Capacity price notices are effective 1 June 2025 at 269.92 USD per MW-day and 1 June 2026 at 301.10 USD per MW-day. A cycle running from 18 May 2026 to 17 June 2026 starts before 1 June 2026, so the whole cycle is billed at 269.92; a cycle starting 18 June 2026 is billed at 301.10.

## Worked line (hypothetical)

Capacity tag 1850.0 kW, capacity price 269.92 USD per MW-day, 31 billing days: 1850.0 multiplied by 269.92 and by 31 is 15479912; divided by 1000 that is 15479.912; the capacity charge line is $15479.91.

## Lines present by treatment

| Capacity treatment of the structure | Transmission treatment of the structure | Capacity line | Transmission line |
|---|---|---|---|
| pass-through | pass-through | yes | yes |
| pass-through | included | yes | none |
| included | included | none | none |
| any expired structure, in holdover | any expired structure, in holdover | yes | yes |
